name_zh: 阿里斯蒂德/海地/神父/民选/政变/流亡/让-贝特朗/拉瓦拉斯/贫困
description_zh: 让-贝特朗·阿里斯蒂德 (1949-) 海地总统 (1991-1995, 2001-2004) 神父出身的民选领导人，通过民主选举掌权，推行社会改革，被美国支持的政变推翻，被迫流亡，建立拉瓦拉斯运动，被誉为 "民选总统", 对拉美民主进程产生深远影响。
description_en: Jean-Bertrand Aristide (1949-) Haitian President (1991-1995, 2001-2004) priest-turned-elected leader, through democratic election gained power, promoted social reform, was overthrown by US-backed coup, was forced to flee, established Lavalas movement, known as "elected president", had profound impact on Latin American democratic process.
reason_zh: 阿里斯蒂德代表拉美民选领导人如何通过民主选举掌权，如何推行社会改革，以及如何建立拉瓦拉斯运动影响拉美民主进程，体现了拉美民主建设的进步性。
reason_en: Aristide represents how Latin American elected leaders achieve power through democratic election, promote social reform, and establish Lavalas movement influence Latin American democratic process, embodies progressiveness of Latin American democratic construction.
